stemMd: An archive rule states: every record marked confidential is encrypted. Some encrypted records are public. No public record is confidential. In column "must", select a conclusion that must follow. In column "possible", select a situation consistent with all rules.
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.

options.label: A
options.textMd: must: Some encrypted records are not confidential

options.label: B
options.textMd: must: Every encrypted record is confidential

options.label: D
options.textMd: must: Every public record is encrypted

options.label: A
options.textMd: possible: Some encrypted records are neither public nor confidential

options.label: B
options.textMd: possible: A public confidential record exists

options.label: C
options.textMd: possible: A confidential unencrypted record exists

options.label: D
options.textMd: possible: No encrypted public record exists

explanationMd: The encrypted public records are not confidential, proving the must conclusion. Rules allow additional encrypted records outside both public and confidential categories, so that situation is possible but not required.

distractorRationale.must-b: The public encrypted records contradict this.
distractorRationale.must-c: The rules allow confidential encrypted records.
distractorRationale.must-d: Only some encrypted records are said to be public.
distractorRationale.possible-b: Public and confidential records cannot overlap.
distractorRationale.possible-c: Every confidential record must be encrypted.
distractorRationale.possible-d: The explicit some-premise requires at least one.
